counter_window_scope: Main paths and hotspot capture counter_end after fixed drive and before final conservation drain. Costs are per fixed input window plus actual status/SQL capture boundaries, not a complete drained lifecycle. Some work may complete during final capture; later drain work has no measured counter delta and is never backfilled. Backpressure recovery and its drain occur before counter_end, so its measured window includes recovery. Warmup/low-flow, registration and final cleanup are outside the steady cost window.
